'''Limbo''' is an island south-west of the [[Isle of Souls]]. It does not have a standard mooring point and can only be reached by [[World switching|hopping]] to a different world while on someone else's boat. [[Junior Jim]] enjoys vacations on the island, to "get away from all the rabble." It is home to two level 5 [[frog]]s, a [[Duck (Kourend Woodland)|duck]] and three [[Crab (Beach)|crabs]].

To exit the island, Junior Jim can transport players to [[The Pandemonium]], or players can hop back to the world they came from to return to the boat.
